They are in a Japanese-style restaurant with dark wooden walls and shelves stocked with sake bottles. The man holds a white paper slip, looking at it intently while the woman watches him with a slight smile. (2) The woman reaches down and pulls out a blue banknote, extending her arm to offer it to the man. She has a cheerful and generous expression. The man looks down at the money while still holding the bill, and the background remains a static indoor izakaya setting with warm lighting. (3) The man uses his hand to gently push the woman's arm away, refusing to take the money. The woman smiles widely, retracts the banknote, and brings her hands together to clap several times in a gesture of gratitude and celebration. She looks toward the camera with a happy face. (4) The man turns his head toward the woman and gestures with his hand as if asking a question. The woman looks down momentarily with a shy expression, then looks back up at him and nods her head slightly. The empty plates and a tall glass of water are visible on the table in the foreground.
